Alternative 1: Full re-build of both lines to 69kV standards, all structures would be removed and replaced with steel, OPGW installed. This option is expected to cost 4% less than the proposed solution, it will not be able to address future load growth in the area and increased capacity per the 2050 Load Study. Alternative 2: Only replace the structures that need immediate replacement (Rolling replacement). This option was not selected as this would put significant risk on reliability of the line with an increasing rate of wood structure asset damage year-over-year. The upper tower sections were replaced and reconductored in 1968 for 138 kV operation, while the lower sections and foundations date to the original 1928 installation. The remaining 3.1 miles are covered under AEP-2019-IM038 and will be addressed through a future solution.
